title.es: Aquel en el que Fina se queda a pesar de Gabriel
title.en: The One Where Fina Stays in Spite of Gabriel

description.es: Fina regresa al despacho convencida de que quiere seguir trabajando en la fábrica a pesar de Gabriel, Marta le dice que la apoyará, lo que incomoda a Cloe. Cloe le confiesa a Valentina que no podrá soportar la complicidad entre Marta y Fina y que es mejor que tome la propuesta de trabajo en Nueva York.
description.en: Fina returns to the office, convinced that she wants to keep working at the factory in spite of Gabriel. Marta tells her that she will support her, which makes Cloe uncomfortable. Cloe confesses to Valentina that she won't be able to bear the closeness between Marta and Fina and that it's better for her to take the job offer in New York.
